prompt: Create one square seamless tileable MEADOW GROUND TEXTURE, filling the entire canvas. Attached image 1 is the locked ground style anchor, image 2 is the locked camp scene anchor. Match their exact fine ink outlines, restrained natural colour wash, two-tone shading and upper-left light.
